ValidationRule.description: If there is other thiird party manufacturer then the name of the product manufacturer must be added
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false && !ISNEW() && (RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' || RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint') && TEXT(Status) = 'Closed' && TEXT(IDR_Complaint_Remedy__c) = '3' && TEXT(IDR_Product_Manufacturer__c) = 'Other' && ISBLANK(Name_of_product_manufacturer__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add the name for other third party product manufacturer
